newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico, Iusacell in radio spectrum deal.
newsitem.headline: Mexico, Iusacell in radio spectrum deal.

text.p: Grupo Isuacell SA de CV, which is Bell Atlantic Corp's wireless investment in Mexico, said on Thursday that it has entered into an agreement with Mexican telecommunications regulatory bodies regarding the commercial use of spectrum in the 450 Megahertz (MHz) band for its wireless project.
The agreement outlines the terms and conditions under which Iusacell could secure the frequencies once the 450 MHz spectrum auctions in Mexico have been completed later this year, Isuacell said.
The agreement also allows Iusacell to expand its current offering of the country's only wireless local loop service trial to up to 50,000 customers, the company said.
The Mexican government recently published a calendar for several spectrum auctions. The auction related to the 450 MHz frequencies is scheduled for October.
